description: Check each unit's plan against your Rego policies. A deny or violation rule blocks merge, a warn rule is advisory, and a unit with no plan to check warns. Conftest's own CONFTEST_* environment variables apply, such as CONFTEST_NAMESPACE and CONFTEST_DATA.

flags.help: The Conftest CLI version the hook installs.
flags.name: cli-version

flags.help: Where your Rego policies live: a path in your repository, or a remote source conftest pull accepts, such as git::https://github.com/org/policies.git//rego. The hook stops if it finds no .rego files there.
flags.name: policies-source

flags.help: Log verbosity. A more verbose PIPELINES_LOG_LEVEL overrides it. One of: trace,debug,info,warning,error,fatal,panic.
flags.name: log-level

name: conftest
title: Conftest
